dedupe_keys.name: attacks on hospitals in gaza 7 october 2023 to 9 october 2025

description: This data set lists every documented attack on a hospital in the Gaza Strip over the two years from 7 October 2023 to 9 October 2025, with what happened to each hospital's operation afterwards. The producers are Maude Fleury and Éloïse Labrecque, who compiled it from the Humanitarian Situation Updates of the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs and the Attacks on Health Care reports of the non-governmental organisation Insecurity Insight. Coverage is all hospitals in Gaza. Each row records the date, hospital name and location, type of attack, reported casualties and detentions among people inside hospital compounds, and whether and when the hospital closed and reopened. The CSV file is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: counts depend on what the two sources could verify during active conflict, casualty figures are as reported, and the definitions of attack types follow the sources. Simulation uses: modelling how the loss of hospitals over time removes bed and trauma capacity from a health system under sustained attack, testing redundancy in referral networks, and validating conflict impact models. Related records: the explosive weapons and health facilities data (data-ewipa-explosive-weapons-health-facilities) and the Syria hospital status data (data-syria-moh-hospitals-status) cover other conflicts.
